response.sql:
WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader AS t
    ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    transaction_count,
    CAST(transaction_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(transaction_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM type_counts
), with_average AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    transaction_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  transaction_count,
  share,
  share - average_share AS share_minus_average
FROM with_average
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: A missing tradekind is grouped as SQL NULL; the window average is the plain average across the resulting trader-type groups. If there are no matched transactions, there are no groups and the query returns nothing.
